name: Nasu no Yoichi
source:
He is a famous archer, and the master of the Nasu family. Even though he always has a bored attitude, his archery skills is better than anyone.

Even though he looks young, he is the oldest in the Yoshitsune army. He seems to have some deep connection with Shigehira……?

Organization: Rebellion
Interest: Pottery (sometimes they are broken by Benkei)

[From the website character profile.]
